speaker: Steve Jobs
event: The Birth of the Mac: Rolling Stone's 1984 Feature on Steve Jobs and his Whiz Kids
content: I know what it's like to have your private life painted in the worst possible light in front of a lot of people. I've learned what it's like for everyone you meet after that to sort of have preconceptions about you... It's been a character-building experience.
